nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Ultra Pure High-Potency 1.5% Hyaluronic Acid Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including those on Accutane or in harsh winter climates, report the serum relieves flaking, tightness and burning and leaves skin plump and soft, though several still need a heavier moisturizer on top.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: some report no irritation, redness or stinging at all, while others describe burning, itching, chapping or heightened sun-sensitivity, one after repeated use.
segments.combination: The few combination-skin reviewers report quick absorption, all-day hydration and no greasiness.
segments.mature: One reviewer applying it on her mother's skin reports visibly more moisturized, softer texture within days; another pairs it with Botox and others mention fading of fine lines/forehead wrinkles with regular use.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report smoother texture and reduced appearance of fine lines or forehead wrinkles with consistent use over weeks to months; one reviewer states it does not visibly help deeper, established wrinkles and is better used preventively.
concerns.dehydration: The great majority of reviewers, especially those with dry skin or in dry/winter climates, report a strong, fast-absorbing hydration boost and plumper, less flaky skin; this is by far the most consistently praised effect.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports the bumps improved substantially; conversely another sensitive-skin reviewer reports her face became bright red and burning after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer states it kept her skin barrier healthy and glowing; a different reviewer reports the opposite, that it left her skin dehydrated and flaky when paired with the Kiehl's moisturizer.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports pimples were smaller or gone the morning after use; another with acne-prone skin says it hydrates well but does not reduce her pimples.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports it does not cause breakouts despite fearing it would be oily; another notes it helped her skin 'clear up' though she had to use it sparingly due to sensitivity.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers explicitly note the serum is not greasy or oily despite being hydrating, including one who feared it would break her out and instead found it non-greasy.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky feel before drying
Stiff glass dropper hard to use

extraits.texte: I have used other hyaluronic acids and was out of my usual, thought I would try yours. It made my face feel dry and itchy plus being bright red. I stopped using it for a week thinking it might be something else. I used it again last night and I woke up to my face burning and feeling chapped. I couldn't recommend to anyone with sensitive skin.

I do like this product, I think it's a good product, the packaging is nice and it actually cleared my face up for me, but I did have to use it super sparingly. I have very sensitive skin and it burned a little bit, I felt like my face was very sun-sensitive for several days

I am only a month into Accutane, and as we all know it causes DRYNESS and BURNING. I was browsing a skincare website and found this as the top serum to use during Accutane. I see why. It has brought my skin back to life and has hydrated it, lessening the burning sensation. This product never burned my skin even in the beginning and I saw results quickly. If you're on Accutane, GET THIS. It will save you.

extraits.titre: Enjoyed using this Kiehl's Hyaluronic Acid serum
extraits.texte: I received this Hyaluronic Acid high potency serum from BzzAgent and Kiehl's recently for testing and review purposes. I have enjoyed using this serum and find it works comparably well and possibly better versus Hyaluronic Acid serums I have used from other brands before. It absorbs quickly and is easily and is extremely gentle and non irritating to my skin, without any kind of sting. It keeps my skin moisturized well throughout the day as well as visibly improving its overall tone/glow around a week in or so, from what I could see. I have combination skin and I am happy with how this product worked for me and would recommend this as a good Hyaluronic Acid serum product to others.

I've been using this as part of my evening routine for about a month now. I use cleanser, moisturizer, then this serum. It has helped my rosacea bumps substantially. The serum is very silky and soaks in quickly. There's a light scent, but not overpowering. This definitely helps with moisturizing in winter months when cream isn't enough.

The hyaluronic acid seriously helps my skin moisturize and prevents wrinkles. It's absorbed very quickly and there's no greasiness or stickiness. My skin is very sensitive and very dry, but this formulation goes on like silk and keeps my face well hydrated all day. Love it!

This hyaluronic acid hydrates my skin like no other product. leaves my skin very soft. I love this product and would recommend it to my friends because it works and leaves my skin beautiful. I have acne-prone skin and this product does not remove any more pimples
